description_en: Retrieve workflow information for a work item
description_zh: 获取工作项工作流信息
name: GetWorkItemWorkFlowInfo

parameters.help_en: Organization identity, also known as organization ID, in string format. It can be obtained from the Alibaba Cloud DevOps access link, for example: https://devops.aliyun.com/organization/【OrganizationId】
parameters.help_zh:
企业标识，也称企业id，字符串形式，可在云效访问链接中获取，如https:
//devops.aliyun.com/organization/【OrganizationId】
parameters.name: organization_id

parameters.help_en: The pipeline configuration ID corresponding to the work item type. This value can be obtained from the following page API request: https://devops.aliyun.com/projex/api/workitem/workitemType/setting/space/getSpaceWorkitemTypeScope?spaceType=Project&spaceIdentifier=c595d0c3df4c743ac811......&workitemTypeIdentifier=ba102e46bc6a8483...... The corresponding Field Value is located in result → configurations → identifier where configType is Workflow.
parameters.help_zh:
对应工作项类型的工作流配置id，该值可以从页面接口请求：https:
//devops.aliyun.com/projex/api/workitem/workitemType/setting/space/getSpaceWorkitemTypeScope?spaceType=Project&spaceIdentifier=c595d0c3df4c743ac811......&workitemTypeIdentifier=ba102e46bc6a8483...... 中获取。对应的字段值在result-> configurations-> 中configType为Workflow的identifier
parameters.name: configuration_id

parameters.help_en: Work item ID, same as the workitemIdentifier field, which is the UUID of the work item
parameters.help_zh: 工作项id，同workitemIdentifier字段，工作项唯一标识
parameters.name: workitem_id
